title: Standing density bounds and unit multiplicity (Simon 5.2.3–5.2.4)
statement: For n ≥ 1 and k ≥ 0 there are δ₁ ∈ (0, 1/8] and C₂ > 0 such that for every δ ∈ (0, δ₁] and all data satisfying (SA_δ): U, W ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} with W open and W ⊆ U; R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M; H : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ^{n+k} μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |H(x)| ≤ κ for all x; R.firstVariation X = −∫⟨X, H⟩dμ for every C¹ compactly supported X with tsupport X ⊆ W; ρ > 0 with the closed ball B_ρ(z) ⊆ W; z ∈ spt μ; μ(B_ρ(z)) ≤ (1 + δ)ω_nρⁿ (ω_n = unitBallVolume n); κρ ≤ δ, and for 0 < t ≤ (1 − 4δ)ρ: (a) μ(B_t(y)) ≤ 2ω_ntⁿ for every y ∈ B_{4δρ}(z); (b) ω_ntⁿ ≤ 2μ(B_t(y)) for every y ∈ spt μ ∩ B_{4δρ}(z); (c) ∫_{B_t(y)} |p_x^⊥(x − y)|²/|x − y|^{n+2} dμ ≤ C₂δ for every y ∈ spt μ ∩ B_{4δρ}(z); and (d) θ(x) = R.mult x = 1 for μ-a.e. x ∈ B_{4δρ}(z). Here p_x is the orthogonal projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x, p_x^⊥ := I − p_x, p_S the orthogonal projection onto a subspace S, |A|² := Σ_i |Ae_i|² the Hilbert–Schmidt norm (the Lean sum over EuclideanSpace.single i 1), B_t(y) the closed ball, and integrals of nonnegative functions are lower Lebesgue integrals in [0, ∞] (Lean ∫⁻ of ENNReal.ofReal).
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∃ δ₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 < δ₁ ∧ δ₁ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ 0 < C₂ ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₁ → ∀ (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k)) (κ ρ : ℝ) (z : Euclid (n + k)), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → 0 < ρ → closedBall z ρ ⊆ W → AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k), ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → z ∈ R.measure.support → R.measure (closedBall z ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + δ) * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) → κ * ρ ≤ δ → (∀ y ∈ closedBall z (4 * δ * ρ), ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ (1 - 4 * δ) * ρ → R.measure (closedBall y t) ≤ 2 * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n)) ∧ (∀ y ∈ R.measure.support ∩ closedBall z (4 * δ * ρ), ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ (1 - 4 * δ) * ρ → unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n) ≤ 2 * R.measure (closedBall y t)) ∧ (∀ y ∈ R.measure.support ∩ closedBall z (4 * δ * ρ), ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ (1 - 4 * δ) * ρ → ∫⁻ x in closedBall y t, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(x - y) - (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - y)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - y‖ ^ (n + 2)) ∂R.measure ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₂ * δ)) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ closedBall z (4 * δ * ρ) → R.mult x = 1)
